title: Maximum Coin Collection
summary: Mario navigates a two-lane freeway with coins placed every mile.
statement: Mario navigates a two-lane freeway with coins placed every mile. Given lane1 and lane2, where each index's value indicates the coin gain or loss in the corresponding mile. Mario starts on lane 1 and can switch lanes at most twice. A lane switch occurs when Mario changes from lane 1 to lane 2 or vice versa. Mario can enter the freeway at any point and exit after traveling at least one mile. The task is to determine the maximum coins Mario can collect, considering the possibility of switching lanes up to two times.
constraints: lane arrays have equal nonzero length and may contain gains or losses.
Enter at any mile on lane one, travel forward at least one mile, and switch lanes at most twice; an immediate switch allows beginning collection on lane two.
Choose the entry, exit, and switches to maximize collected coins.
hints: The best route ending at a mile depends only on its lane and switches used.
Maintain six maximum-subarray states, permitting a fresh lane-one start or a lane-two start that consumes one switch.
At each mile extend the same lane, transition from the other lane with one more switch, or initialize a legal route; update the global best.
Every route has one final-mile state and one of these predecessors, so the recurrence covers all entry, exit, and switch choices.

tests.explanation: Enter lane one, use beneficial switches, and exit with a maximum collection of fourteen.
Enter lane one and immediately switch before collecting to take seven from lane two.
